name: Carrion Defense Works Nerve Agent Micro-Dart System NAMDS-1 'Whisper'
description: A wrist-mounted micro-dart launcher that fires a near-invisible carbon-fiber dart loaded with a fast-acting nerve agent. The dart is 8mm long, thinner than a human hair at its widest point, and delivered by a compressed gas micro-charge that is nearly silent. The nerve agent — Carrion's proprietary NeuroHalt-7 — causes rapid paralysis of the respiratory system within 90 seconds of injection, and the dart is small enough that most targets do not feel the impact. The NAMDS-1 is the weapon of choice for operators who need a target to die quietly, in public, with no apparent cause of death until a very thorough autopsy finds a carbon-fiber splinter smaller than an eyelash.
specifications:
dart size: 8mm length, 0.1mm diameter carbon fiber
propulsion: Compressed gas micro-charge, 28 dB acoustic signature
effective range: 1-5 meters
toxin: NeuroHalt-7 fast-acting respiratory paralytic
time to effect: 60-90 seconds
magazine: 3 darts
weight: 0.05 kg total wrist unit
detectability: Dart is undetectable without microscopic examination
story_hooks: Three high-profile deaths in one month, all attributed to sudden respiratory failure, all in public settings — the connection is invisible without knowing what to look for.
A retired Carrion operative is selling their personal NAMDS-1 along with detailed operational logs of every target they ever hit with it — the buyer gets the weapon and the blackmail material.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist wrist-mounted apparatus that resembles a tactical chronograph crossed with a medical injector. The profile is deliberately understated — a slim, angular band that sits flush against the forearm with an almost invisible firing mechanism. No obvious barrel or aggressive geometry; instead, it presents as sophisticated medical tech repurposed for lethal precision.
physical_description.dimensions: Wrist unit: 12cm length × 3.5cm width × 2cm depth. Firing orifice diameter: 1.2mm. Total dart length: 8mm × 0.1mm diameter.
physical_description.weight_description: Featherweight. Barely perceptible on the wrist — weighs less than a smartwatch. The user feels it more as a presence than a burden, allowing hours of wear without fatigue.
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-alloy casing with aerospace-grade polymer underlays. Dart fabrication: uncoated carbon-fiber with nano-etched tip.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with subdued brushed finish. Zero reflectivity. The surface is deliberately non-reflective to avoid catching light or surveillance imaging.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary, with muted charcoal and near-black accent plating around the firing mechanism. No logos or bright indicators — visual camouflage.
physical_description.grip_texture: Micro-textured silicone underlayer adheres to skin or synth-leather gloves. The wrist band is wrapped in non-slip medical-grade polymer that molds to individual wrist contours.
distinctive_features: Micro-pneumatic pressure gauge (barely visible dial, 2mm diameter) recessed into the wrist band
Three tiny cartridge window indicators — clear synthetic showing dart count
Hairline seam running the length of the unit indicating dart magazine chamber
Firing trigger: integrated into palm-facing surface, requires precise finger position and grip pressure to activate
Minimal LED indicator (infrared-only) for charge status, invisible to naked eye
Micro-calibration screw (1.5mm hex) for range compensation — only visible if actively maintained
Pneumatic exhaust vents disguised as ventilation slots along the underside
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS engraved in 2pt font on the inner wrist surface — only visible to wearer during donning. No serial plate; unmarked by design. A microscopic tally mark appears on the titanium casing for each successful deployment, hidden under the wrist band.
physical_description.condition_typical: Meticulously maintained. Operators keep this pristine — no corrosion, no wear patterns. A used unit shows only micro-abrasions from regular field handling. The weapon exists in a state of clinical readiness, suggesting its owners understand that any visible degradation signals careless operator discipline.
